fact_text: By 17 Jul 2026 the successor to Pakistan's auto policy, which expired in 2026, had not been announced, and talk was of extending the existing policy by one year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Drafts had suggested cheaper plug-in hybrid and hybrid vehicles, but the FY27 budget raised their sales tax to 25% from the 8.5% and 12% brackets they were charged at.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Battery electric vehicles kept a 1% sales tax, and the interviewee said EVs from well-regarded brands start at about 7 million rupees at that rate.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Taxes and duties make up about 50 to 52% of the price of a CKD-assembled vehicle, according to the analyst, which he said is why cars are so expensive.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Auto financing is capped at 3 million rupees with a 3-year tenure limit, which the analyst said restricts affordability and holds back car sales.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Passenger car and LCV sales grew about 39% in FY26, but the analyst said this came off a very low base after import restrictions in FY23 stopped plants for part of the year.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Passenger car and LCV sales peaked at about 344,000 units in 2022, and the analyst said the market has since stayed flat or shrunk.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: About 240,000 vehicles were assembled locally from CKD kits in FY26, according to the interview.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The CKD kit import bill was cited as about 2.5 billion, currency not stated, alongside the roughly 240,000 locally assembled units.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: About 13 EV makers have entered the Pakistani market under the recent policy, according to the analyst.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: About 31 players are manufacturing vehicles in Pakistan, offering buyers more variety of models than before.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Players entering under the 2021-2026 policy have reported margins of up to about 27%, while three to four legacy makers ran at around 13 to 14%, according to the analyst.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Most models launched by the new entrants sell in the 7 to 10 million rupee bracket, which the analyst said is not entry-level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: In the FY26 budget the concessional 12.5% sales tax on the 850cc entry-level car was removed and the rate went back to 18%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Cuts to additional customs duty, regulatory duty and RD under the National Tariff Policy lowered prices of imported 3000cc-plus vehicles by about 3 to 5 million rupees in FY26.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The FY27 budget introduced a special excise duty that raises the price of vehicles above 2000cc, even after the ACD and RD cuts, the interviewee said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Sales tax is 18% on most goods and 25% on luxury goods, and the interviewee said cars above 1400cc or 4 million rupees fall in the 25% bracket.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The government plans to cut the used car import duty by 10% each year, which would bring it to 0% by 2030.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The government said it would cut CKD duties alongside CBU duties, but the analyst said this budget narrowed the promised 15% edge that local assemblers had over CBU and CKD imports.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The analyst estimated that only about 6% of the population can afford cars in the current price range, which leaves a large gap in who can buy.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Prices of some vehicles in the 12 to 16 lakh rupee range rose after the FY27 budget, which the interviewee said hit buyers by 5 to 7 lakh rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: High-volume running models reach about 60 to 70% localisation, while makers with small volumes find local parts cost more than imports, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Parts from China are cheaper because of economies of scale and heavy Chinese government subsidies to the auto sector, so local assembly cannot compete on cost, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Chinese entrants chose mostly SUVs because US and European tariffs pushed Chinese makers toward SUV-heavy markets, so few sedans came to Pakistan.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The analyst said entrants that have taken five years of policy benefits may leave if the business stops being viable, and that only four to six players may survive five to six years on.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Legacy makers avoid new investment because annual budget changes and amendments to the auto policy keep reversing the rules, which the analyst said is a major deterrent.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Makers would rather sell two to three thousand fewer vehicles a year than invest in models that a policy change could make unviable, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Indus Motor, one of the legacy makers the interview called a joint venture, does not assemble plug-in hybrids in Pakistan, which the analyst attributed to inconsistent policy; it would lose only about 2 to 4% of share if ICE sales fell.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Legacy makers such as Honda have not moved into local hybrid assembly in Pakistan, though the technology is available to them, the analyst said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: BYD announced a plant in Pakistan, but as of 17 Jul 2026 the work had not started, the interview said.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The government target is for battery electric vehicles to make up 30% of new vehicle sales by 2030, which the analyst doubted is achievable because early adopters have already moved.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Shifting to EVs and hybrids is meant to cut Pakistan's dependence on imported fuel, which weighs on the import bill and emissions targets.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Buyers worry about steep depreciation on EVs and plug-in hybrids, and the analyst said resale value after about four years is a key concern for them.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Government plans for highway EV charging stations have slowed, which the analyst said limits EV use for long-distance travel and adds to range anxiety.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: With no public transport alternative, high car taxes discourage demand, and the analyst said pushing supply alone will not grow car sales.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: Buyers who paid the 18% sales tax rate fear a later tax cut will make their cars cheaper, which the analyst said calls for a consistent policy so buyers are not exposed to sudden swings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The policy benefited buyers who could already afford imports, giving them more models and features, but offered no route for first-time car buyers or motorcycle owners to move up.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: PAMA-reported sales of passenger cars and LCVs in FY26 were about 26,000 vehicles, against a 2022 peak of 344,000.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The budget raised taxes on cars with 600cc and 800cc engines, which the speaker cited when questioning how luxury status is defined for cars.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)

fact_text: The speaker said no country localises car manufacturing 100%, since some imported components are always needed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's New Auto Policy Delayed: Will Car Prices Finally Come Down?| Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2026-07-17)
